title: How a Man of God Owns the Mistake Before Anyone Names It
caption:
Anyone can admit fault once they're caught. The test is admitting it before anyone had to catch you.

Going first into the cost is what leadership actually looks like. Not being in charge. Not being right. Being the one who owns it first, apologizes like it matters, and lets the truth cost him before it costs anyone else.

Who's the man in your life who goes first? Tell him.

#faith #christianmen #manofgod #leadership #integrity
theme: He leads by going first into the cost.
